# Ben McCormick

> Design engineer. Personal site for selected work across React, WebGL, interface design, and animation.

## Work

- [Artifice](https://artifice.sh/): An instrument for exploring generative art.
- [Fragments](https://fragments.supply/): Learn creative coding with shaders using Three.js and TSL.
- [Gravitics](https://gravitics.app/): Audio stimulation given visual form.
- [The Studio](https://thestudiophysio.com/): Website for a boutique physiotherapy and pilates studio.
- [Shadercraft](https://shadercraft.phobon.io/): Curated shader art, learning, and the people who make it.
- [Formation](https://formation.phobon.io/): Generative shader experiences.
